Four years ago, I wrote a declaration for freedom in mainland China. It has become a book: In the People's Name.

No party owns a country. No leader owns its people.

Read the free English edition, with sources:
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/en/

posts.text:
四年前，我写下了一份关于中国大陆自由的宣言。

现在，它扩展成《以人民之名》：追问共产主义的平等承诺如何变成支配，人民怎样约束声称代表自己的权力。

没有哪个党可以拥有一个国家。

中文全文免费，附章节注释：
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/zh/
posts.x_confirmation: Will send on Tue, Sep 22, 2026 at 8:00 PM

posts.text:
Communist revolution promises equality. But who can hold the revolutionary party accountable when it controls people's work, resources and right to dissent?

Chapter 4 examines the power exercised in the workers' name.
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/en/chapter-04/
posts.x_confirmation: Will send on Wed, Sep 23, 2026 at 9:00 AM

posts.text:
共产主义革命承诺消灭阶级特权。但当革命政党控制工作、资源与表达异议的机会时，劳动者又怎样约束声称代表自己的组织？

第四章《以平等之名》，从这个问题展开。
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/zh/chapter-04/
posts.x_confirmation: Will send on Wed, Sep 23, 2026 at 8:00 PM

posts.text:
Being called a country's master means little if you cannot question the officials who decide how you live.

Chapter 5 examines CCP rule through three powers: who decides, who distributes resources, and who may say a decision is wrong.
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/en/chapter-05/
posts.x_confirmation: Will send on Thu, Sep 24, 2026 at 9:00 AM

posts.text:
被称为国家的主人，却不能追问决定自己生活的官员，意味着什么？

第五章从三个相互连接的权力审视中共统治：谁作决定，谁分配生活资源，谁能够说决定出了错。
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/zh/chapter-05/
posts.x_confirmation: Will send on Thu, Sep 24, 2026 at 8:00 PM

posts.text:
Can people gain economic choices while remaining unable to remove their rulers?

Chapter 6 follows China's reforms and asks whether the rights behind prosperity survive when those in power change their minds.
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/en/chapter-06/
posts.x_confirmation: Will send on Fri, Sep 25, 2026 at 9:00 AM

posts.text:
能够选择怎样挣钱，是否也意味着能够选择谁来统治？

第六章讨论中国的改革开放：个人获得了哪些选择？当掌权者改变主意，保护这些选择的权利还能否有效？
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/zh/chapter-06/
posts.x_confirmation: Will send on Fri, Sep 25, 2026 at 8:00 PM

posts.text:
Who holds sovereignty? Who makes the rules? Who can make the rule-makers answer to the people living under them?

Chapter 8 examines Hong Kong through these three questions. A handover alone cannot answer them.
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/en/chapter-08/
posts.x_confirmation: Will send on Sat, Sep 26, 2026 at 9:00 AM

posts.text:
谁拥有主权？谁制定规则？谁能让制定规则的人承担责任？

第八章从这三个问题审视香港。主权交接完成以后，居民仍然需要追问：自己的权利由谁保障，承诺受到侵蚀时能够向谁追责？
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/zh/chapter-08/

posts.text:
Ten outlets repeating one account are not ten independent witnesses.

Who had access? Who controls the records? Who risks a career by speaking?

Chapter 10 asks how power shapes what the public can know—and how a lone warning can be heard.
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/en/chapter-10/
posts.x_confirmation: Will send on Sun, Sep 27, 2026 at 9:00 AM

posts.text:
十家媒体重复同一份说法，不等于十份独立证据。

谁接触过原始材料？谁控制记录？谁因开口而冒着失去职业的风险？

第十章追问：权力怎样影响公众知道什么，孤立的预警又怎样被听见？
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/zh/chapter-10/
posts.x_confirmation: Will send on Sun, Sep 27, 2026 at 8:00 PM

posts.text:
Warnings from people such as Dr. Li-Meng Yan deserve protection and independent scrutiny.

Preserve the records. Protect people from retaliation. Test specific claims.

Chapter 11 asks how early warnings can help prevent the next disaster.
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/en/chapter-11/
posts.x_confirmation: Will send on Mon, Sep 28, 2026 at 9:00 AM

posts.text:
对闫丽梦博士等提出警报的人，保护安全、保存原始材料、安排独立核验，应当同步推进。

不能让揭露者独自承担代价，也不能让任何人的声望取代证据。

第十一章讨论：怎样更早预警，避免下一次伤害？
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/zh/chapter-11/

posts.text:
Opposing the CCP's one-party rule also means asking how to constrain whoever comes next.

Can ordinary people dissent, keep their livelihoods and make the powerful answer?

Chapter 12 brings freedom back to that test. Read, question and share.
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/en/chapter-12/
posts.x_confirmation: Will send on Tue, Sep 29, 2026 at 9:00 AM

posts.text:
反对中共的一党专断，也必须追问：谁来约束下一批掌权者？

一个没有背景的普通人，能否在表达异议后继续工作、照顾家人，并让有权势者回答问题？

第十二章把自由带回这个尺度。欢迎阅读、质疑与分享。
https://my-freedom-foundation.github.io/declarations/zh/chapter-12/
